import html # Predefined template with placeholders for name, biography and status PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

{status}
""" def generate_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A user‑written biography (may contain multiple sentences). status : str The user's current brief status message. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string ready for inclusion in a web page. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required placeholders are missing from PROFILE_FORMAT. """ # Validate that all placeholders exist in the template required_keys = {"name", "bio", "status"} missing = required_keys - set(PROFILE_FORMAT.format_map(lambda k: k).keys()) if missing: raise ValueError(f"Missing placeholders in PROFILE_FORMAT: {missing}") # Escape user input to prevent XSS (CWE-707 mitigation) safe_name = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Format the template with sanitized values rendered_profile = PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status) return rendered_profile
